familiarity_question: Before this session, how familiar were you with Wau Kikik?
familiarity_options: I had no prior knowledge of Wau Kikik.

tasks.title: Find a starting point
tasks.instruction: Read the opening message and use the topic menu to find something you want to know about Wau Kikik.

tasks.title: Explore a name or a form
tasks.instruction: In your own words, ask about a name or a shape mentioned in the guide. Ask a follow-up question if you want more detail.

tasks.title: Check the evidence
tasks.instruction: Ask about a feature of Wau Kikik. Open a source card and compare the answer with the quoted passage.

tasks.title: Explore the flying account
tasks.instruction: Ask about one aspect of the book’s account of launching, controlling or competing with Wau Laga. Use your own wording.

tasks.title: Try a clarification
tasks.instruction: Ask a short question that leaves a detail unclear. If the guide asks for clarification, explain what you meant. Observe what actually happens, including any difficulty.

tasks.title: Ask your own question
tasks.instruction: Ask another question you are curious about. It is fine if the book does not answer it. You can try a follow-up or restart the conversation.
